notes:
-- Account summary:
- Large regional health system focused on EHR search for clinicians (inpatient + outpatient notes).
- Primary interest: embeddings + reranking (hybrid search) to improve recall and precision for diagnosis retrieval and care-plan snippets.

-- Workload & scale:
- Target index: ~50M notes (avg 1.2k tokens per note), expect nightly incremental ingest 200k notes.
- Query pattern: physician-facing search, peak QPS 80-120, 95th p99 latency target for search+rerank <200ms (soft) but will accept 300ms for first POC.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost/query <= $0.003 for full search + rerank; exploring dedicated pools + quantization to hit cost target.

-- Model & infra preferences:
- Prefer private deployment behind VPC / on-prem for PHI; will evaluate Dedicated if Private proves heavy.
notes_addendum:
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization (INT8/LLM-specific) and batching policy tuned to peak QPS.
- Reranker plan: bi-encoder for candidate retrieval + cross-encoder rerank. Customer wants option to host reranker on GPU-dedicated pool (low-latency).
- Caching: prefix/KV caching not applicable to retrieval; want response caching for repeated clinician queries.

-- Security & compliance:
- BAA mandatory, SOC2 required. Customer needs audit_logging and immutable access logs for every tokenized retrieval.
- No egress from inference hosts; must support private KMS key (HSM preferred).
- Data residency: primary data must remain in us-east-1.

-- Quotes / direct: "We cannot permit any PHI leakage — logging, access and key management are showstoppers. BAA before POC."

-- POC plan & success metrics:
- POC scope: ingest 10M notes (de-identified sample agreed), build vector index + reranker, 2-week evaluation.
- Metrics: MRR uplift vs baseline search + precision@5, end-to-end p95 latency, cost per query. Target: +18% MRR, p95 latency <350ms, cost/query <= $0.003.
- Milestones: data ingest (week 1), index build + tuning (week 2), live evaluation with clinicians (week 3).

-- Open questions for Redwood:
- Can Private package be air-gapped for on-prem deployment? (legal asked explicitly).
- Support for FIPS/KMS integrations and customer-managed HSM?
- Reranker hosting: recommended latency profiles for cross-encoder on a dedicated GPU pool at 100 QPS?
